newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast products mixed as traders watch APIs.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast products mixed as traders watch APIs.

text.p: U.S. West Coast products prices turned narrowly mixed midday, in the wake of early profit-taking and quiet trade as players watched the release of inventory data from the American Petroleum Institute.
"Gas did trade off from yesterday," one West Coast broker said, referring to November NYMEX gasoline, which traded 0.64 cent lower at 65.70 cents a gallon late in the morning.
API reported PADD 5 West Coast gasoline stocks rose 636,000 barrels for the week ended October 4. Meanwhile, inventories of heating oil dropped 195,000 in the western regions.
